topic: Constexpr Optimizations in STL for Performance
explanation: This concept explores how `constexpr` functions and variables enable compile-time computation, influencing memory layout and runtime performance.  We'll examine how compilers optimize `constexpr` code, potentially eliminating runtime overhead entirely and leading to significant performance gains. We will also discuss the limitations of `constexpr` and situations where compile-time evaluation might not be possible, focusing on the interaction between `constexpr` and external factors, such as I/O or dynamic memory allocation.
